sourceChecks.text: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEBの本文と前後の系譜・名簿を照合した。

profileDecisionJa: ネタネルの子でレビ人の書記シェマヤは、祭司とレビ人の奉仕組を記録しました。彼は王や諸長の前でその記録を取りました。

wikipediaSearchEvidence.searchReasonJa: 標準英語表記と該当章節を検索し、Wikipedia本文の対応箇所を実読した。

wikipediaReadEvidence.locator: List body, lines 111–115; bullet at line 114 identifies Shemaiah son of Nethanel as a scribe and cites 1 Chronicles 24:6.
wikipediaReadEvidence.support: The list directly distinguishes this Shemaiah by his father Nethanel and scribe role at 1 Chronicles 24:6.
